avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces almotriptan levels; potential serotonin syndrome risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; allow 2-week washout before or after St. John's Wort

avoid_supplements.name: 5-Hydroxytryptophan (5-HTP)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive serotonergic effects increase risk of serotonin syndrome
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; do not use concurrently with almotriptan

avoid_supplements.name: L-Tryptophan
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Increased serotonin precursor may potentiate serotonin syndrome risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; monitor for serotonergic symptoms if unavoidable

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential mild CYP3A4 induction; possible additive stimulant effects
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for reduced efficacy or increased cardiovascular stimulation

caution_supplements.name: Valerian
caution_supplements.mechanism: Minor CNS depression effects; may enhance drowsiness
caution_supplements.action: Counsel on potential additive sedation; advise cautious use

avoid_foods.name: High-dose tyramine-containing foods (aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented foods)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Triptans cause vasoconstriction; tyramine increases blood pressure and may precipitate hypertensive crisis
avoid_foods.action: Advise patient to limit tyramine intake; monitor blood pressure if consumed

caution_foods.name: Caffeine
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS stimulation; may increase tremor, jitteriness, or tachycardia
caution_foods.action: Counsel to moderate caffeine intake during migraine treatment; monitor for excessive stimulation

monitoring_notes: Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, confusion, rapid heart rate, high blood pressure, dilated pupils, muscle rigidity) especially when almotriptan is combined with other serotonergic agents. Counsel patients to report any unusual symptoms and avoid abrupt discontinuation.
